200.title: Polish foreign minister proposes creating European Legion involving Ukrainian veterans
200.summary: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski has called for the creation of a European Legion which Ukrainian veterans, among others, could join after the war ends.
200.body: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski has called for the creation of a European Legion which Ukrainian veterans, among others, could join after the war ends. Source: Sikorski in an interview with Greek outlet Kathimerini Quote: "As the European Union, we need far deeper military integration. This is why I strongly advocate for a 'European Legion', a dedicated, standing force that could recruit seasoned professionals from the broader European family, including battle-hardened Ukrainian veterans after the war." Details: Sikorski stressed that Europe must take responsibility for its own security. Nonetheless, the Polish foreign minister emphasised that this would not mean creating a parallel alternative to NATO or duplicating its structures.

400.body: News | Science Electricity grid operator cancels power call ahead of eclipse Neso had taken the ‘precautionary measure’ to make sure it had a ‘greater safety cushion’ between demand and energy supply on Wednesday evening. The National Energy System Operator had issued the notice in the early hours of Wednesday, ahead of the solar eclipse (PA) PA Media Henry Saker-Clark 20 hours ago Britain’s electricity grid operator has cancelled its call to the industry to generate more power during Wednesday evening’s solar eclipse. The National Energy System Operator (Neso) had issued the notice in the early hours of Wednesday, saying it was taking the “precautionary measure” to make sure it has a “greater safety cushion” between demand and energy supply. The electricity grid operator had called on energy producers to help deliver a contingency of around 676 megawatts.
